native_checker_script:
import argparse,gzip,hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--output',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
ref=json.loads(gzip.decompress(Path('docs/heuristic-aggregation-reference.json.gz').read_bytes()))
exe=Path('build/petri-comparison-checkpoint-build/Release/minera_export.exe');before=hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest();checks=[]
for i,r in enumerate(ref['observations']):
 x=Path(f'build/aggregation-check-{i}.xes');x.write_text(r['xes']);out=x.with_suffix('.json')
 row={'name':r['name'],'expected':r['expected']}
 try:
  proc=subprocess.run([str(exe),str(x),'--heuristic-variant','classic','--heuristic-decoration','performance','--heuristic-performance-aggregation',r['aggregation'],'-o',str(out)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
  row.update(exit_code=proc.returncode,stderr=proc.stderr)
  if proc.returncode==0:
   net=json.loads(out.read_text())['heuristics_net'];stat=net['relation_statistics'][0]
   if r['aggregation']=='raw_values': actual=stat['wait_samples']
   elif r['aggregation']=='all': actual={agg:stat[key] for agg,key in [('mean','mean_wait_seconds'),('median','median_wait_seconds'),('min','min_wait_seconds'),('max','max_wait_seconds'),('sum','sum_wait_seconds'),('stdev','stdev_wait_seconds')]}
   else: actual=net['edges'][0]['representation']
   row['actual']=actual
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: row['timeout']=True
 row['matched']=row.get('actual')==row['expected'];checks.append(row)
 if (i+1)%160==0: print(i+1,'checked',flush=True)
after=hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert before==after
Path(a.output).write_text(json.dumps({'checks':checks,'native_executable_sha256':after},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(sum(r['matched'] for r in checks),'/',len(checks));print([r['name'] for r in checks if not r['matched']][:20])
